newsitem.title: USA: Arson suspect nabbed in S. Carolina caravan park.
newsitem.headline: Arson suspect nabbed in S. Carolina caravan park.

text.p: A fugitive with ties to a Moslem group suspected of murder and arson was arrested in a South Carolina caravan park where he had been living, the Federal Bureau of Investigation said on Friday.

Edward Flinton, 50, was taken into custody on a charge of unlawful flight from prosecution in Lake City, Sout Carolina, a rural community midway between Columbia and the coastal resort city of Myrtle Beach.

Authorities said he was running from a 1993 conspiracy indictment connecting him with the Arizona murder of Moslem leader Rajad Abbel Khalifa. The 54-year-old cleric was found stabbed to death in Tuscon's Majid mosque on Jan. 31, 1990.
Flinton also faces an arson conspiracy charge stemming from the August 1984 burning of a Hari Krishna temple in Denver.
Authorites said Flinton waived extradition to Colorado during an arraignment before a South Carolina magistrate.

Flinton had been a member of Al-Fuqra, a militant Islamic organisation Colorado authorities say was linked to the murder and arson and to racketeering. Six other members of the group also were indicted on conspiracy charges linked to the Khalifa murder.
Flinton was remanded to South Carolina's Florence County jail without bond after his arraignment on state charges of being a fugitive from justice.
